title: Bather Bending by Reflective Pond Edge, 1950s Countryside B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A solitary figure in swimwear bends forward at the edge of a tranquil, glassy pond or lake, their form cast against the dark reflections of surrounding foliage. Cattails and tall water grasses line the bank, while across the water a dense tree line rises toward a roadside bank. An overhead utility wire angles through the sky in the upper left. Featuring distinctive mid-century deckled borders, this candid capture embodies the simple pleasures of rural leisure and warm-weather exploration in postwar America.
